no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (relation, activity, organisation, group, place) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep how things in the person's records are related, with the role as data, and what happened between them, as relation and activity records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:relate-records and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Each relation says subject is the role of object ("record:crm:pat" is the "dad" of "me"; a contact is a "member" of "organisation:Example Club"); subject and object are record ids, me, or <kind>:<name> for an organisation, group or place, made once by its name.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: relation (records:read, records:list, records:write); activity (records:read, records:write); organisation (records:read, records:write); group (records:read, records:write); place (records:read, records:write).
